FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Inspection inquiries should be directed to Sam Thompson, Operations Manager at Timber Craft Creations, reachable at (555) 123-4567.
FIELDS.GL CODE: General Liability code for woodworking and carpentry operations is not accepted for structural framing or load-bearing construction.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Timber Craft Creations, we specialize in custom woodworking and carpentry projects that emphasize quality craftsmanship while adhering to safety protocols and industry standards. Our operations focus exclusively on non-structural interior projects, allowing us to minimize liability exposure. We have a well-equipped workshop that utilizes modern machinery, regularly maintained to ensure optimal performance and safety. Our team is trained in best practices for woodworking, including dust control methods, to maintain a safe working environment and prevent health hazards. We do not engage in any structural framing or load-bearing construction, thereby reducing our risk profile and focusing on delivering bespoke furniture and cabinetry solutions tailored to our clients' needs.

Our business specializes in custom carpentry and woodworking, including the construction of structural frames and load-bearing elements for residential and commercial projects.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "Prior losses included a minor incident in March 2021 due to a machinery malfunction, resulting in a claim of $2,500. The issue was resolved with no ongoing status, and safety protocols have been enhanced since then."
